rawContent: @SenatorLankford #ClimateCrisis is an existential issue for humanity. Failing to deal with it will create an impetus for additional migration of immigrants from devastated countries. Be consistent. Slow the activity at the border by addressing #ClimateEmergency now. Anything else is just blather.

@SenatorLankford You are making things worse by failing to deal with #ClimateCrisis and refusing to modernize immigration laws. You just whine. You are in the US Senate. You could do something if you wanted to. Whining is easier. You are failing @SenatorLankford

@GOPChairwoman And they’ll never recover the lives they’d built when their homes burn because of #ClimateCrisis - hurricanes, fires, destroyed crops, dried rivers. I’d pay $1500 to have our earth back, clean air and water, moderate temperature and usual rain patterns, a productive clean ocean.

“We don’t inherit the earth from our ancestors, we borrow it from our children.” 

Think about that, @SenatorLankford as you continue to ignore the #ClimateCrisis enveloping us. Do something. As you force more women to bring children into this world, at least make it habitable.
